introduction.en: This update fixes extension startup, messaging, notifications and duplicate context menu items.
introduction.fr: Cette mise à jour corrige le démarrage, les échanges, les notifications et les menus contextuels des extensions.

title.fr: Les échanges fonctionnent dès le départ.

body.en: Companion extensions can connect as they start together without losing their first messages. Pages and workers keep receiving events during startup.
body.fr: Les extensions complémentaires peuvent se connecter lorsqu’elles démarrent ensemble sans perdre leurs premiers messages. Les pages et les processus d’arrière-plan continuent de recevoir leurs événements.

notes: Extensions that talk to each other through a port, such as companion extensions starting together, no longer wait forever for an extension that is not ready, and no longer lose the first messages on a fresh connection.
An extension page or worker no longer sometimes stops hearing its events, or waits forever on its calls, when it opens at the same time as another part of the extension.
